description: The chart represents the distribution of various categories related to speech, audio, and music. The pie chart is divided into 7 slices, each representing a different category. The categories and their corresponding proportions are: Speech (29.4%, light purple), Mix-Sound-Speech (22.3%, very light purple, though the label is partially obscured), Music (20.6%, light purple), Sound (16.5%, light purple), Mix-Music-Speech (8.2%, purple), Mix-Sound-Music-Speech (2.4%, dark purple), and Mix-Sound-Music (1.1%, dark purple). The chart does not include a legend, but some slices have percentage labels inside or adjacent to them. The slices are arranged in a rough descending order of size, with the largest slice, Speech, at the top right and the smallest, Mix-Sound-Music, at the top. One slice, Mix-Sound-Speech, has a partially obscured label due to a gray box overlay.
